summary: Frontend-only Apro-Vision ESG dashboard tested end-to-end via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 6 routes (Home, Companies, Solutions, Supplier Report, Conformity, About) render correctly with the expected data, components, navigation flows and color-coded risk badges. No backend testing performed (frontend-only build, no /api endpoints by design).
action_items: [INFO ONLY - not a bug] Spec doc says data-testid='nav-link-{label}' / 'sidebar-link-{label}' with label cases like 'Home', 'Risk Radar' but the implementation correctly uses lowercase + hyphenated labels: 'nav-link-home', 'sidebar-link-risk-radar' etc. Both sidebars (desktop+mobile drawer) exist in DOM so each sidebar-link selector returns 2 matches (count=2). Update spec doc OR keep as-is - functionality works.

[INFO ONLY] Selector `[data-testid^="data-source-"]` returns 5 hits on Conformity but only 4 data-source cards are visually rendered (matches mockData.ts). The 5th is likely an inner element sharing the prefix - cosmetic, no UX impact.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well structured with proper TypeScript types, lazy-loaded routes, suspense fallback, and a centralised RISK_COLORS theme.
All required data-testid attributes are in place and discoverable via the spec.
RiskMap uses inline <button> with raw style instead of MUI Button - acceptable inside leaflet popup (avoids portal issues).
SupplierReportPage gracefully handles invalid id with 'Supplier not found' message and Back-to-Risk-Radar action.
Mock data is realistic (textile hubs Dhaka, Tirupur, Karachi, Guangzhou, etc.) with consistent risk levels.
verified_features: Home page: hero title 'Apro-Vision', 4 stat cards, both CTA buttons present and navigate correctly (View Companies -> /companies, Open Risk Radar -> /solutions)
Top nav: 5 links (home/companies/solutions/conformity/about) with active route highlight (color change on active link confirmed via computed style)
Sidebar: 5 items including 'Risk Radar', plus sidebar-collapse-btn
Companies page: 6 rows render, search 'Aurora' filters to 1 row, risk-filter-select present, clicking row navigates to /supplier/{id}

Solutions page: Leaflet map renders with 15 .risk-marker dots, floating map-legend in top-left, clicking a marker opens popup with map-popup-{id} and View details button that navigates to /supplier/{id}

Supplier report /supplier/s2: name 'Dhaka Knitwear Cooperative', 4 KPI cards (Pollution Index, 12-Month Trend, Process Category, Last Sentinel Scan), pollution-chart-card with 24 .recharts-line-dot data points, anomaly-list-card with at least 2 anomaly-item-* entries (4 for HIGH risk supplier)

Conformity page: 4 visual data-source cards, legal-disclaimer-card with the exact spec text ('analytical insights derived from publicly available satellite data sources... must not be interpreted as formal accusations, legal determinations, or verified compliance judgments'), download-whitepaper-btn present
About page: workflow-diagram with 5 workflow-step-{1..5} cards
Footer renders with ESA reference on every page
Risk badge colors verified via computed style: HIGH = rgb(200, 54, 45) == #C8362D as per spec (RISK_COLORS in theme.ts)
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: N/A - all data is mock/hardcoded in mockData.ts
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend-only (no backend calls). Lazy routes need Suspense settle time (~1-2s). Sidebar appears twice in DOM (desktop + mobile drawer) so sidebar-link-* selectors return count=2 - this is expected. Public URL: https://pollution-tracker-eu.preview.emergentagent.com . All testids work with lowercase labels (e.g. nav-link-home, sidebar-link-risk-radar).
